Tebra provides an all-in-one EHR platform for independent healthcare practices. The company is seeking a Software Engineer I to develop and modernize its Practice Management platform by designing scalable solutions and maintaining critical backend services. The role also involves collaborating across teams, participating in Agile development and code reviews, and applying emerging technologies including AI tools.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and maintainable software applications using Spring Boot, Java, and cloud technologies
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to architect robust and scalable solutions that meet business requirements. Provide input into the technical direction of the team and product
Build, test, and maintain critical services that serve as foundational building blocks for product features, as well as improve team efficiency and effectiveness
Participate actively in the code review process, both by receiving constructive feedback on your own pull requests and reviewing peers' PRs to learn codebase standards and best practices
Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming. Contribute to defining and prioritizing work within the team
Continuously research and apply emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve the development process and product quality
Use AI tools to support the software development process

Required
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
• 0-1 years of professional software development experience (1+ years of internship experience desirable)
• Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts, data structures and algorithms
• Excellent problem-solving skills, ability to optimize performance, and scalability
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
• Problem solver by nature who genuinely enjoys writing code
• Positive attitude with a strong desire and drive to learn
• Strong interest or hands-on experience in AI-focused development (e.g., building with LLM APIs, prompts engineering, or experimenting with local AI tools/frameworks)
Preferred
• Preferred: experience with Spring, version control, and relational databases
• Hands-on experience with Python and related frameworks (e.g., Django, FastAPI, Flask,) is preferred
